lines.en: My activity grid had only four boxes.

lines.ko: 칸 하나를 하루에서 한 시간으로 내렸습니다.
lines.en: One box is now one hour, not one day.
Across is 24 hours and down is the last 7 days.

lines.ko: 나흘 동안의 커밋 399개가 여기 다 들어 있습니다.
lines.en: All 399 commits from those four days are in there.
The commits-today number was frozen at 21.
Every visitor's browser asked directly and hit the limit.

lines.ko: 이제는 서버가 5분에 한 번 대신 셉니다.
lines.en: Now the server counts once every 5 minutes for everyone.

lines.ko: 실제 사이트에서 숫자가 정말 움직이는지 봐야 합니다.
lines.en: I need to watch the number actually move on the live site.
lines.art: a tiny robot leaning in to watch a brass counter dial tick upward

lines.en: The front page is finally alive.
